iqm-emerald.source_timing: live IQM Resonance Target of 'emerald', fetched 2026-10-26 (get_backend(use_metrics=True)), medians over 54 qubits / 84 pairs: r 24 ns (all equal), cz 40 ns (range 40-60 ns), measure 360 ns (all equal). IQM publishes no repetition time (no numeric value found in iqm-client, iqm-pulse docs or AWS pages); its default reset is 'reset by waiting (relaxation)': iqm-client CircuitCompilationOptions.active_reset_cycles = None, https://docs.iqm.tech/iqm-client/api/iqm.iqm_client.models.CircuitCompilationOptions.html, and the Reset_Wait gate idles 'for a time comparable to the relaxation time of the component', https://docs.iqm.tech/iqm-pulse/api/iqm.pulse.gates.reset.Reset_Wait.html. ASSUMPTION (user's decision): per_shot_overhead 250 us = IBM Marrakesh's default_rep_delay (see ibm-marrakesh), a wait between shots like IBM's; IQM publishes no repetition time and resets by relaxation, so the real wait may differ (median T1 of this Target 52.8 us)

iqm-sirius.source_fidelity: 96.83 = the median over the 240 ordered qubit pairs of F(MOVE pair of the moved qubit q2) × F(CZ of q1 with the resonator), the CZ between two qubits through the resonator: F(MOVE pair) is IQM's randomized benchmarking of the circuit MOVE → MOVE back (irb.circuit.move_ncz_move, n_interleaved_gates=0), F(CZ) the irb CZ fidelity of the locus's implementation (tgss on QB2 and QB10, crf_crf on the others); checked against the direct measurement of MOVE·CZ·MOVE (n_interleaved_gates=1, 16 pairs), which it matches within 1 percentage point; from the live IQM Resonance calibration of 'sirius' (calibration set d26f1f86-cd08-4ae2-be8c-6ca3bb787a21, measured_at 2026-10-26T05:48:41Z); assumptions: r_ct 0.5
iqm-sirius.source_pricing: Braket does not offer Sirius: the project's synthetic estimate, Emerald's per-shot price x 0.3/0.75 Resonance credits per second (2026-09-28)
iqm-sirius.source_timing: live IQM Resonance Target of 'sirius', fetched 2026-10-26, medians over 16 qubits / 240 pairs: r 40 ns, cz 232 ns (range 208-288 ns; includes the resonator MOVE operations, as in the VLQ snapshot), measure 400 ns; per_shot_overhead 250 us = IBM Marrakesh's default_rep_delay, same ASSUMPTION as iqm-emerald (median T1 30.3 us)

ionq-forte.source_timing: arXiv 2506.08940 (Forte Enterprise 1: 63 us 1q, 650 us 2q, 250 us readout); arXiv 2603.15515 gives 130 us / 950 us instead, Azure's Aria table 135 us / 600 us (https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/quantum/provider-ionq); per_shot_overhead 3 ms = laser cooling, verified in the PDF (Quantum accepted version of arXiv 2308.05071, Sec. 2, p. 2-3): 'The laser cooling process takes approximately 3 ms' (sequential Doppler and EIT cooling; an earlier fetch extract wrongly said 33 ms); the same paper gives 110 us per 1q gate and ~900 us per ZZ gate; the optical-pumping duration, readout and time per shot are not stated, so state preparation is only the cooling
